title: Industrial Design Co-op – Summer 2027
note: Forklift and material-handling ID co-op for students in a bachelor's Industrial Design program; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Summer co-op on Crown's industrial design staff at the New Bremen, OH headquarters.
facts.duties: User and field research, sketching, renderings and models, ergonomic test bucks, CMF and form decisions with engineering, CAD of appearance parts, product graphics, presentations.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in a bachelor's Industrial Design program; good communication; reliable transport between company sites. Crown does not sponsor; temporary-visa holders are not eligible.
